verdict.rationale: Rive documents RML, an XML text representation of a Rive file that lets you create and modify Rive content as code outside the Editor. Its runtimes, which load .riv files, are open source, so the binary format is at least inspectable. A community comment notes that the open-source pieces still require the Rive Editor to build content, and nothing shows a published .riv specification or that RML files can be produced and compiled independently of Rive's own tooling. Missing for 10: a published .riv format spec, evidence that RML or .riv round-trips without vendor tools, and independent hands-on corroboration of third-party tooling.
